`UserIcon` is used in two places in the patient chart, both inside local `InfoTooltip` helpers, and both only render it as a 16px icon inside a button. Changing its behaviour would affect those two helpers and the components that render them.

**Definition:** `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/icons/icons.tsx:824`. It is a memoised `forwardRef` wrapper around `Icon` with `omrs-icon-user`. The framework docs list it as an exported variable. I did not read the `esm-framework` re-export itself, so that link is inferred from the docs.

**Confirmed affected in the chart:**

1. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/components/medications-details-table.component.tsx:379` renders `<UserIcon size={16} />` inside a `ghost` `IconButton` whose label is the orderer name. This is the `InfoTooltip` at lines 376–382.
2. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/components/medication-record.component.tsx:110` renders `<UserIcon size={16} />` inside a `ToggletipButton` that shows the orderer in a `Toggletip`. This is the `InfoTooltip` at lines 105–117.

**One hop outward:**

- `MedicationsDetailsTable` (`medications-details-table.component.tsx`, line 204) renders the first `InfoTooltip` when not printing. It is used by the active, past, future and summary medication components in `esm-patient-medications-app`.
- `MedicationRecord` (`medication-record.component.tsx`, line 27) renders the second `InfoTooltip`. It is used by `OrderDetailsTable` (`esm-patient-orders-app/src/components/order-details-table.component.tsx`, line 561).
- `order-details-table.test.tsx` mocks `MedicationRecord`, so that test would not see a change. `medication-record.test.tsx` renders the real component and could be affected.

**Likely but unverified:**

- The four medication list components that render `MedicationsDetailsTable` (`active-medications`, `past-medications`, `future-medications`, `medications-summary`). I saw their usage lines but did not read their declarations.
- The mock files `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/mock.tsx:99` and `mock-jest.tsx:98` define a stub `UserIcon`. They would only matter if the chart's tests import these mocks, which I did not check.

**Not checked:** I did not check whether any other repository in Falkon uses `UserIcon` beyond the two chart files and the core definitions. The repository-level search covered only these repositories. Dynamic or string-based references would also not appear in these searches.
